what: User request 2026-10-06 (relayed by the reviewer): the main place uses the new chat. ChatVersion cannot be written by scripts (RobloxScript capability) and the one-time screen operation could not open the Properties dropdown, so the user switched TextChatService.ChatVersion = TextChatService by hand. ChatWindowConfiguration was reset by script to the Roblox default (HorizontalAlignment Left, VerticalAlignment Top, WidthScale 1, HeightScale 1; was Left/Bottom 0.85/0.80).

checks_own_test_play_pc_1280x720.channels: RBXGeneral (me), RBXSystem (me), RBXTeamReally red (me = 뿔 군단), RBXTeamNew Yeller, RBXTeamTeal, RBXTeamMedium stone grey (CreateDefaultTextChannels: one team channel per faction Team)
checks_own_test_play_pc_1280x720.announce_system_message: DebugCommand Announce RareWeapon:4:Goblin -> RBXGeneral SYSTEM message 'Darugi_S2님이 고블린에게서 희귀 무기 [숲도둑 황금 지팡이]을(를) 얻었어요!' (Announce.luau new-chat path: DisplaySystemMessage)
checks_own_test_play_pc_1280x720.team_chat: RBXTeamReally red:SendAsync('진영 채팅 테스트') -> received on the team channel, bubble chat over the character (the /t command of CreateDefaultCommands switches to this channel)
checks_own_test_play_pc_1280x720.filter: TextChatService filters every message server-side in live servers; Studio does not run the full filter, so it is not certified here.
checks_own_test_play_pc_1280x720.photo: Studio MCP screen_capture does not include CoreGui (the chat window and the top bar), so no chat-window photo from here; the bubble is visible in the viewport capture. A real look at the chat window needs a person (or a desktop screenshot).

not_checked: phone 749x361 chat window look (CoreGui not capturable), name-hiding vs chat names (chat always shows the Roblox display name, in the old chat too).
studio_state_after: Play stopped, device default, Edit mode. Place not saved to file yet (next place commit).
